hypothesis: Add Taste Calibration Ladder (Phase 0) — systematic taste progression diagnostic with domain-specific dimensions, calibration levels, targeted training, and anti-rigidity gate
benchmark_task: Design an AI taste training program for Authority Flywheel operators — developing discernment for content quality
changes: Added Phase 0: Taste Calibration Ladder to ai-quality-gatekeeping-protocol.md
7 domain-specific taste dimensions with adapt-per-domain guidance
5-level calibration scale (Binary to Generative) with behavioral descriptors
Bottleneck-first training priority (lowest dimension = training focus)
Targeted Exposure Prescription with 3-consecutive-correct progression rule
Anti-Rigidity Gate: evaluate rejected styles on own terms every 5 cycles
Style Exposure Log: minimum 3 distinct styles per domain per month
notes: First taste-mastery skill evolved. Key insight: the existing Taste Stack (4 levels) described destinations but zero mechanism for getting there. The Calibration Ladder decomposes taste into independent perceptual channels and provides measurable progression criteria. Anti-Rigidity Gate prevents taste calcification — the most dangerous failure mode for experienced evaluators.
